Package mpl1.thelastguest.view.ui

Class ActionMenu

java.lang.Object
mpl1.thelastguest.view.ui.ActionMenu
public class ActionMenu extends Object
UI overlay that displays a context–sensitive action menu when the player right-clicks on a tile, character, or empty space.

The menu allows performing actions such as:

  • Moving to a location
  • Searching
  • Talking to NPCs
  • Inspecting dead characters
  • Scanning fingerprints
  • Unlocking rooms
The menu dynamically adapts to the clicked tile and the player's available actions. It is rendered on a separate Stage.

  • Method Details

    • display

      public void display(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 mousePosition, List<Character> npcs, Board board)
      Displays the action menu at the given mouse position.

      The method determines whether the clicked tile contains a character. Depending on the target (NPC or empty tile), the menu displays different sets of actionable buttons (move, talk, inspect, scan, unlock, etc.).

      Parameters:
      mousePosition - The screen coordinates where the menu should appear.
      npcs - A list of NPCs used to determine whether one occupies the clicked tile.
      board - The board, used primarily to check room lock states.
